page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the left margin. Running head at top, page number 22 at top left. Digitiser watermark at bottom right, not transcribed.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: &ta[?], portu quoque celebris, in Fivelingiis: Winscota, & quondam florens, nunc Hudtibus Dullarti attrita, peneque hausta, Midwolda, cum fano quatuor turribus late conspicuo, in praefectura veteri: ut de Reiderwolda iisdem in partibus funditus deleta, quâ medius fere Dullartus fluctus nunc agitat, fileam, omnibus prioribus quondam ampliore ac ditiore.

Egregia ad haec aedificiis ac opulentiâ monachorum & sacrarum virginum Coenobia in agro fuere numero xxv: ante caetera vero Adoardia in Medachiis, quinque vicis imperans, famosisque opibus inclyta, superbo imprimis fano, ad modum & dimensionem aedis Clara-vallensis magnificentissimè structo, vi-senda[?], aedificiis variis ac multis frequens, munitionibus & portis, ut oppidum, clausa, familiae Bernardinae: tum Vetus Dammonae vicinum Benedictinarum virginum, & alterum eodem nomine ac ejusdem ordinis in Marnensibus: Rottum, Warfumum, Thesingaeum, Selwerdia, Grisomonachum, Wittowerumum, Osterwerumum, Wytwerdia, Hilligerlaa, Schiltwolda; Essena

page.notes: Printed note in left margin beside the second paragraph, "Coenobia vel clau-stra mona-steria", three short lines, transcribed inside the paragraph at that place. Small marks at the top right ("1" and "3" beside the running head) are not transcribed as text; they may be signature or stray marks and are uncertain. The "&ta" opening word is uncertain because the first letter is a ligature and may be "et"; marked [?]. "vi-senda" is uncertain at the line-end hyphen. Whether "Essena" is correct is uncertain, though it appears clear.
